title: Upper airway anatomy
description: The conducting corridor: nose conditions the air, pharynx crosses food and air, larynx turns air into voice and guards the lungs, trachea delivers.

questions.question: What is the path of air through the upper airway?
questions.answer: Air enters the nose or mouth, passes through the pharynx and larynx, then moves down the trachea toward the bronchi.

questions.question: What does the epiglottis do during swallowing?
questions.answer: The epiglottis is one structure involved in protecting the laryngeal entrance during swallowing; coordinated movement of the larynx and vocal folds also matters.

questions.question: What is the nasal cavity & conchae?
questions.answer: Three conchae turbo-charge the surface area. Function: Warms, humidifies and filters inspired air.

questions.question: Where is the nasopharynx & adenoid located?
questions.answer: Posterior nasal chamber with lymphoid adenoid. Function: Air passage; immune sampling in childhood.

questions.question: What is the function of the epiglottis?
questions.answer: Function: Flips to cover the larynx during swallowing. Elastic leaf above the larynx.
